description: Multi-turn conversation: vague initial goal, agent probes, user clarifies piece by piece.

conversation.content: I want to get better at SQL.
What part of SQL is giving you trouble, and what's your current level?
Joins mostly. I've been writing SQL for about two years but joins still trip me up in complex queries.
Got it. Are you looking for a deep theoretical understanding or just want to be confident writing them day-to-day? And how much time can you invest?
Day-to-day confidence is the goal. I can spend about 5 hours this week.

expected_goal.sub_goal: write SQL joins confidently in day-to-day queries
